answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system through a prism of stake-based validation to resist Sybil attacks. Each agent is assigned a unique identity tied to a costly stake, which can be thought of as a saffron-colored digital token. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities must acquire and lock up a corresponding amount of nectar-like tokens, making it economically infeasible to create a large number of Sybil identities, thus securing the network.
